vacancy_energetics.provenance: Li, Guo & Robertson, J. Phys. Chem. C 119 (2015), DOI 10.1021/acs.jpcc.5b02430. Absolute neutral V_O formation energies on rutile (110): sX 4.39 / 4.98 / 5.70 eV, GGA 3.71 / 4.10 / 4.79 eV (surface / first subsurface / bulk). Relative values are used; the oxygen chemical potential cancels in the canonical ensemble. Site energies are polaron-relaxed: Ti3+ small polarons are not explicit variables (context: Reticcioli et al., Phys. Rev. B 98 (2018) 045306).

surface_ordering.pair_table_note: Pair energies are calibrated, not computed: chosen so that spacings of 1-2 bridging sites are suppressed and the modal spacing near critical coverage is 4-5 sites, with the ordering energy scale of the published low-energy configurations (~0.2-0.3 eV). Replace with project DFT configuration energies when available.
surface_ordering.provenance: Birschitzky et al., npj Comput. Mater. 10 (2024), DOI 10.1038/s41524-024-01289-4. DFT+U (U = 3.9 eV) + ML + Metropolis MC on rutile (110): experiment reports an average reconstruction onset near 17%, DFT places the transition near 20%, and vacancy-rich local regions reach about 20%; these values mark a phase-change interval, not a maximum allowed coverage. Interaction range is ~10 A, in-row spacings of 1-2 sites are nearly absent, and the most probable spacing is 4-5 sites. Reconstruction mechanism: Reticcioli et al., Phys. Rev. X 7 (2017) 031053, DOI 10.1103/PhysRevX.7.031053.

surface_phases.note: The (1x2) reconstruction is treated as a competing surface PHASE, not a cap and not an extrapolation: the (1x1) vacancy lattice gas holds up to theta_transition; there the added-row Ti2O3 phase takes over by a first-order transition (lever-rule coexistence at fixed mu_V), with a stoichiometric areal O deficiency of theta_reconstructed_eff = 0.5 in bridging-monolayer units (one added Ti2O3 unit per (1x2) cell = one O vacancy per two bridging sites). Declared idealisations: the reconstructed phase is a zero-width line compound (no configurational entropy; cross-linked (1x2) variants not distinguished), and no surface phase beyond theta_eff = 0.5 is modelled. theta_transition is the experimental onset; the DFT value 0.20 bounds the interval (sensitivity, not a second phase).
surface_phases.provenance: Added-row Ti2O3 structure of the (1x2): Onishi & Iwasawa, Surf. Sci. 313 (1994) L783; confirmed stable under reduction by DFT+U: Reticcioli et al., Phys. Rev. X 7 (2017) 031053, DOI 10.1103/PhysRevX.7.031053. Transition location: the 17-20% onset interval of Birschitzky et al. (see surface_ordering.provenance).

saturation.note: x_max_shear is the approximate rutile point-defect range before crystallographic shear (CS) planes; the partition uses it as the bulk solubility: theta_sol = x_max_shear/2 pins mu_V at the estimated rutile / CS-phase coexistence, and inventory beyond that total precipitates as extended defects by the lever rule (reported as its own output, not forced into the point-defect classes). The value is approximate and is labelled an estimate wherever it is used. subsurface_dilute_warn flags the first subsurface O layer leaving the dilute regime; read that as a heavily reduced near-surface shell, not isolated vacancies.

co2_kinetics.note: Placeholder effective kinetics: k_c = A_c p^m exp(-Ea_c/kT), P_c(t) = 1 - exp(-k_c t). The barriers are the first-sketch values; the prefactors are EFFECTIVE, far below an attempt frequency for the deeper classes because subsurface and bulk refill are transport-limited, and are set to give a plausible recovery pattern at 600 C / 300 s / 0.2 atm (surface complete, subsurface partial, bulk negligible). Replace with fitted or DFT values; none of these numbers is a literature result.

dielectric_correlation.note: Empirical dielectric loss factor of this work: linear regression of log10(eps'') on log10(VO_total), i.e. eps'' = 10^a * VO^b with a = -3.07028 +/- 0.695 and b = 1.22355 +/- 0.2302 (OriginLab, no weighting, N = 4, Pearson r 0.96637, R^2 0.93388, adj. R^2 0.90082, RSS 0.18029). Fitted over roughly 95-5000 umol-O/g; below that range the value is an extrapolation and the card marks it. Set eps_prime to display tan delta.
dielectric_correlation.provenance: Measured in this work (Kwak et al.): dielectric loss factor vs total oxygen-vacancy content from H2O-integration titration of reduced rutile.

kinetics_cgmc.note: Coarse-grained KMC of reoxidation transport, after the group's framework: radial coarse cells over the particle, exchange rates R(k->l) = Lambda_kl eta_k (q_l - eta_l) exp(beta eps_k) with a symmetric kernel Lambda_kl = nu0 a^2 A_kl exp(-beta E_TS) / (d_kl v_O q_k q_l) and a common saddle E_TS = E_m + eps_bulk, so the activation to leave cell k is E_TS - eps_k. This satisfies detailed balance against the product-binomial Gibbs measure with H = sum eps_k eta_k (the closed system relaxes exactly to the (1x1) three-class equilibrium split) and reduces in the dilute limit to the finite-volume discretisation of spherical diffusion with D = a^2 nu0 exp(-beta E_m). Surface refill (CO2) is the one irreversible channel and uses the surface entry of co2_kinetics. Reconstruction kinetics are not modelled: the transport network uses the (1x1) site classes. E_m defaults to the neutral-vacancy bulk barrier; with it, transport is NOT rate-limiting at 600 C - a measured partial recovery therefore reads back as an EFFECTIVE barrier (charged migration, trapping, aggregation), which the panel can fit.
kinetics_cgmc.provenance: Framework: Katsoulakis & Vlachos, J. Chem. Phys. 119, 9412 (2003), DOI 10.1063/1.1616513; Katsoulakis, Majda & Vlachos, Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. USA 100, 782 (2003). E_m default: Iddir et al., J. Phys. Chem. C (2010), DOI 10.1021/jp107986a (neutral V_O, c-axis).

experimental_recovery.note: Measured CO2 recovery for the overlay on the sweep plot; empty until digitised from experiment.

diffusion_eV.note: Stored for a later kinetic version; not used by the equilibrium model. The surface-to-subsurface exchange barrier is a different path and is not any of these numbers. The planned kinetic layer follows the coarse-grained kinetic Monte Carlo framework of the group: radial coarse cells over the particle, Arrhenius exchange rates, detailed balance against the same Gibbs measure, q^2 time coarse-graining.
diffusion_eV.provenance: Bulk: Iddir et al., J. Phys. Chem. C (2010), DOI 10.1021/jp107986a. Surface (unstrained rutile 110): Wang et al., Phys. Rev. B 82 (2010) 165309. Coarse-grained KMC framework: Katsoulakis & Vlachos, J. Chem. Phys. 119, 9412 (2003), DOI 10.1063/1.1616513; Katsoulakis, Majda & Vlachos, Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. USA 100, 782 (2003).
